_: Golden for the be.fluvius-zenne-dijle.household preset – D2 §9 1, 6 and 9, D9 §3. Every number carries its source.

sources.price: VREG, 'Fluvius Zenne-Dijle - ELEKTRICITEIT - Tarieflijst periodieke distributienettarieven 2026 - Afname' (FZD - 2026 - ELEK.pdf), read 2026-09-23: 'Afnameklanten op laagspanningsnet met piekmeting – Gemiddelde maandpiek EUR/kW/jaar 56,1228635', valid 01/01/2026 to 31/12/2026, excluding VAT. The sheet's minimum contribution for these customers equals 2.5 kW x this rate.
sources.minimum: Same page: "Iedereen betaalt een minimumbijdrage. Die bijdrage komt overeen met een piek van 2,5 kW." Fluvius: "We rekenen bij een digitale meter sowieso een minimale maandpiek van 2.5 kW aan."
sources.metric: Fluvius, fluvius.be/.../aangerekend: "het hoogste kwartiervermogen per maand" – the highest quarter-hour of the month. VREG on the billed figure: "de 'facturatiepiek' ... Dat is het gemiddelde van de gemiddelde maandpieken van de afgelopen 12 maanden." That is per_day = all, per_period = max, period = rolling_months 12.
sources.seed_bills: Constructed: eleven months at a flat 4.00 kW so the rolling mean is arithmetic anyone can check. Fluvius prints the twelve monthly peaks on the bill, which is what `seed_from_bills` is for (D2 §2).
sources.windows: One December quarter-hour at 0.25 kWh = 1.00 kW: a quiet month, deliberately under the 2.5 kW minimum so the floor is load-bearing.
sources.metric_kw: The plain rolling mean, which is what the metric reports: (11 x 4.00 + 1.00) / 12 = 45.00 / 12 = 3.75 kW.
sources.fee: D2 §5.3: the minimum applies to each month BEFORE the mean. Eleven months bill at 4.00, December at max(1.00, 2.50) = 2.50, so the billed mean is (44.00 + 2.50) / 12 = 46.50 / 12 = 3.875 kW; 3.875 x 56.1228635 / 12 = 18.123008 EUR for the month.
sources.not_fee: The same arithmetic in the wrong order – max(mean, 2.50) = 3.75 – gives 3.75 x 56.1228635 / 12 = 17.538395 EUR. The golden asserts the fee is not this (D2 §9 9).
sources.price_period_unit: BE quotes EUR/kW/year, so the month pays a twelfth (D2 §4, §5.3).

minimum._: D2 §9 9 verbatim, on the file: two known months at 1.0 and 2.6 kW.

rolling._: D2 §9 6, on the file: the thirteenth month pushes the first one out.

twelve_months.why: (10.00 + 11 x 4.00) / 12 = 54.00 / 12 = 4.50; the December window is 1.0 kWh over a quarter-hour, which is 4.00 kW and leaves the seeded month unchanged

thirteenth_month.why: 2026-01's 10.00 kW leaves the window and January 2027's 6.00 kW enters: (11 x 4.00 + 6.00) / 12 = 50.00 / 12 = 4.166667
